---
argmap-version: 0.3
title: "IABIED: The Comprehensive Case"
author: "extraction round 4 (LLM-extracted from primary sources, human-reviewed)"
date: 2026-06-18
description: >
  The maximal refinement of iabied-unfold.argmap (extraction round 4,
  2026-06-18). Where iabied-unfold was extracted from the McAleese review and
  the book's chapter-index summaries, this map is authored from the full ground
  truth: the book (epub), every official per-FAQ supplement page at
  ifanyonebuildsit.com, and the McAleese review plus its comment thread.
  Essentially every supplement objection becomes an objection/response node
  cluster; every major claim is grounded; the book's parables and the Part II
  takeover scenario are paraphrased into folded glosses. (The original "no
  verbatim passages: the file is publishing-bound" rule was superseded by the
  2026-07-27 D59 pass below: short attributed quotations now ride on `>` quote
  lines, each bound to its locator.) Adds the structural corrections the full text
  reveals: an independent @wont-solve-in-time pillar (Ch11), @incidental-kill
  under @mis-ext, orthogonality grounded in Ch1 prediction/steering, the
  before/after gap and asymmetric engineering analogies (Ch10), the
  easy-call/hard-call epistemics (Intro), and the superalignment and
  unfalsifiability rebuttals. AUTHOR-FAITHFUL since 2026-07-19: every solver
  input (frontier marginal, evidence strength) and every display check is
  derived from the book authors' verbatim confidence language via the fixed
  pre-registered rubric (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-17 pilot + 2026-07-19
  map-wide campaign). The map represents the argument in IABIED from the
  book authors' perspective, and a badge means the authors' own numbers do
  not deliver their own conclusion there (a coherence audit of the book, not
  extractor disagreement). Rubric-derived numbers keep the `?` marker
  (D18/D23: a bare value is reserved for numbers the authors state as
  numbers); the few reviewer-sourced grounds with no author language keep
  role defaults and are listed in the residual log. A deliberate format
  stress-test at ~400 nodes. See FINDINGS.md round 4 for the strain it
  surfaces. 2026-07-20: risk-conditional rebuttal guards on seven Ch13
  rebuttals, plus policy-region accessibility grounding (@risk-norms,
  the stated-odds pair); ported to -de/-tw the same day. See
  AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-20.
  2026-07-27: format v0.3. The 200 inline verbatim spans became 128 `>`
  quote lines under 85 nodes (D59), each bound to its source locator and
  byte-identical across the three maps. Auditing every span against the
  sources corrected 14 that were not in fact verbatim; the register
  fragments left in `#` trailers were audited the same day (8 corrected,
  no number moved). See AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-27.
  2026-08-02: J-round sourcing pass, EN ONLY (@everyone-dies pinned against
  the vacuous "everyone dies eventually" reading; $built-ev grounded in the
  ch. 12 incentives passage, cited as ch. 13 until the 2026-09-12 locator fix;
  no number moved).
  2026-08-02: world-interface pass, EN ONLY (FEEDBACK B2, the Bernhard
  session, in which a reader who granted the spine stalled inside @wed-lose on
  "an ASI cannot interface with the physical world"). Six ch. 6 statements
  un-buried from @attack-vectors' comma-run gloss (@truth-terminal,
  @led-side-channel, @mail-order-dna, @self-repl-factory, @robot-fleets,
  @minimal-actuators) with three wiring evidences; @no-hands-answered and
  @attack-vectors become derived and move their authored marginals to
  `# check:` trailers. Numbers rubric-derived and pre-registered as usual.
  The ch. 7-9 parable mechanisms enter as `>` quote lines ONLY, because ch. 7
  footnote i disclaims the route, so they carry no probability and move no
  solved value.
  2026-08-03: $link directness pass, EN ONLY (FEEDBACK B2 again: three
  reader sessions faulted the spine edge for describing itself instead of
  asserting). Its label now states the book's title sentence, the wayfinding
  moves to the second clause of the gloss, and the intro quote already under
  $link-fine is duplicated onto the collapsed form (the two are never on
  screen together). No number moved. The reader-facing frontmatter key this
  spoke also owed was already supplied as `source-title:` by the
  site-map-attribution pass that landed first; parity is indifferent to it
  either way, since it only requires `title:` and `description:` to be
  present in a translation.
  2026-08-03: BOTH 2026-08-02 passes above are PORTED INTO -de by the
  second German pass (ideas/plans/content-german-pass.md), which also read
  the whole German map as a native reader and repaired one EN label under
  TRANSLATION_NOTES G5 (@airgap-leak: "leaks via radio from memory access"
  hid a choice German forces (what escapes, signals or data), so the EN now
  names it). The $link pass's one quote line was ported into -de at the
  merge of the two branches (2026-08-03), so EN/DE parity is GREEN.
  2026-08-08: all four maps in full parity; TW ported including the dash
  recast, CN re-derived from the ported TW via tools/tw2cn.py.
  2026-08-15: EN-ONLY answered-attack additions (audit round): @halt-warscale
  + $enf-hard-resp (Ch13 political-will answer), @easy-call-shape +
  $resp-precedented (Introduction easy-call answer), $uc-precedented
  re-banded 0.15 -> 0.3 pre-response. Ported to DE/TW/CN 2026-08-15 (CN
  derived from the ported TW via tools/tw2cn.py); parity green again.
  2026-08-16: EN-ONLY declared-group pass (D58, layout-motivated but
  editorially real), refined same day to FOUR groups after the measured
  bake-off of cuts: ::policy-batteries (the benefits objection + the ch13
  battery + the warning-shot, succession and fatalism supplements) and
  ::feasibility (the enforceability objection, the treaty mechanism moved
  up adjacent, and the political-will answer) and ::standing-grounds (the
  off-ramp and the governance question) inside @shutdown's block;
  ::alarm-objections (the ch12 meta-objections + the contamination
  cluster) inside $shutdown-ev's refinement. Group ids kept; labels and
  glosses rewritten the same day in the editorial pass (plainer,
  cold-parseable namings per Felix's feedback). Display-only
  (transparency invariant D58: no factor, number or solve changed; the
  re-baked importance sidecar moved only its meta hash); the treaty
  section's physical relocation into ::feasibility is the one line-order
  move. Parity stayed intentionally red until the 2026-08-17 port (below).
  2026-08-17: second declared-group wave, EN ONLY, extending the pass to
  the other nested boxes: nine more groups, one per banner-delimited
  objection battery, every membership already contiguous so NO line was
  relocated. ::power-objections (the ch1 battery, in @int-power's box),
  ::worry-objections (the intro battery plus the consciousness
  objection, @asi-soon), ::todays-ai-objections (the ch2 battery) and
  ::training-objections (the ch4 battery, both in @imprecise's box),
  ::analogy-objections (the ch10 battery, @eng-hard),
  ::plan-objections (superalignment, the ch11 battery, truth-seeking
  and early warnings, @wont-solve-in-time), ::stop-objections (the
  countermeasure objections, @wed-lose), ::implication-objections (the
  precedent, expert-spread and death-race challenges, $link's box),
  ::scenario-objections (the Part II FAQ battery, @takeover-scenario).
  Labels are reader questions, PROVISIONAL pending Felix's rename.
  Display-only again (D58 transparency invariant; no factor, number or
  solve changed). Same day, after group folding (D124) landed and Felix
  reviewed in the browser: the skeptic family (@skeptics,
  $skeptic-attack, @no-forecast, $uc-skeptic) moved INTO
  ::worry-objections (it is the intro battery's senior-researcher
  dismissal; its shared ground @whether-vs-when stays outside as a
  boundary premise), and ::standing-grounds was REMOVED: with the
  battery shelves folded by default its clustering job is done by the
  folding, and its only remaining effect was hiding the positive case
  behind a card (measured: without it the four supports sit visible
  within 200px of the claim at near-identical canvas). The full port
  (twelve :: lines, the treaty relocation and the skeptic-family move)
  landed in DE/TW/CN 2026-08-17, CN derived from the ported TW via
  tools/tw2cn.py; parity green again.
  2026-08-21: EN-ONLY gloss pass (GLOSS_STYLE-2026-08-15 memo, rules R1 to
  R10 and the 2026-08-21 rulings O1 to O7; AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-08-21).
  Text only: the 25 bare multi-premise evidences gained warrant labels
  (R5), the memo's fourteen-item batch landed as ruled, every reader-facing
  "arguendo" became plain words (R3), 45 inline quote shards moved to `>`
  lines as the source's whole sentence (R9, one O2 call per node), and the
  ten most important box heads plus all twelve group heads carry a verbatim
  book sentence with a wayfinding sentence and one image (Q7, R4, R10).
  No node, edge, number or check trailer moved; the importance bake is
  byte-identical on every score. Ported to -de/-tw/-cn the same day
  (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-08-21, the port entry); parity green again.
  2026-08-23: the two-floor elicitation pass, EN ONLY (D152 item 4;
  ideas/plans/content-two-floor-pass.md phases 4 and 5; the ratified
  register-to-pair table, AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-08-23). Eleven pinned roots
  the map or the book already argues for are DERIVED: the argument is
  wired, the authors' total moves to a `# check:` and the residual stays
  empty, so a badge there reads "the authors' own grounds under-deliver
  their stated confidence". Three of the eleven were the W25 rows (a bare
  point beside mapped support), which is now silent on this map. Every
  remaining pin, all 224, is rewritten as a D53 two-floor pair whose width
  is its rubric register's, so the map states an interval where the authors
  stated one and the point is no longer asserted on their behalf; the class
  token now sits in every trailer, so no later pass has to class by value.
  Three junctions that ANDed a statement with its own derivative factor the
  shared span out ($wst-race, $eng1, $imprecise-ev). Headline: @everyone-dies
  0.763 to 0.758, @shutdown 0.971 to 0.965, badge family 8 to 12, all inside
  the pre-registered budget. Numbers rubric-derived and pre-registered as
  usual; nothing was tuned to close a gap. See AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-08-23.
  Ported to -de/-tw/-cn the same day (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-08-23, the port
  entry): pairs, checks, class tokens and wiring byte-verbatim, only the new
  labels and glosses translated; parity green again.
  2026-09-08: the hope batteries re-authored after the semantics campaign's
  movement census (campaign W5-E; AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-09-08, the W5-E
  entry). The four hopes that the ASI WOULD care (parents, fascinate,
  moral, kinder) argued for ~@no-right-care while being conditioned on it,
  so they leave $hope-care and dock at the exit as objection/response
  triples, each answered on the page's own answer to the inference (the
  premise's denial already rides on its pin); @c5-care-little retires as a
  restatement of ~@no-right-care (D152 item 1) and its route stays as the
  bare wish; $hope-care reads "five hopes, one wish". $hope-harmless's
  objections drop the ~@instrumental-convergence conjunct (the negation of
  every answer's ground, so no answer could fire where a hope held), the
  satisfied-AI page's even-if answer becomes $c5-leave-resp2, and the
  digital and selfish premises are re-read from the pages' own words; the
  boring hope moves there; $c5-promise-obj is keyed hope. The wrappers'
  own numbers and glosses stand (Felix's ruling 2026-09-08: the gap between
  a wrapper's composition and its authored number is the finding, not a
  thing to tune). Every new number is rubric-derived from verbatim text.
  Ported to -de/-tw/-cn the same day.
  2026-09-09: kind split of the two biggest battery shelves, EN ONLY
  (tracker content.md "Sub-group the big battery shelves by objection
  kind", the 2026-08-20 kinds): ::policy-batteries gains ::halt-costs,
  ::halt-enforcement and ::halt-alternatives, its two pairs staying flat;
  ::plan-objections gains ::plan-technique, ::plan-world and
  ::plan-racing, the reckless-labs objection staying flat. Families move
  whole, by kind (the one line-order change); no line is rewritten.
  Display only (D58 transparency): no factor, number, check or solved
  value moved (@shutdown 0.994, @everyone-dies 0.827, @wont-solve-in-time
  0.963 before and after). Parity was red on -de/-tw/-cn for the day
  (six :: lines and the re-ordering), then nine by the evening; see the
  closing line of this note.
  Later the same day, the five-kind form for Felix's look: the two pairs
  boxed as well, ::halt-messaging (panic, messaging) and ::halt-granted
  (succession, hopeless), so ::policy-batteries' direct children are all
  folded shelves. That shape does not lay out in the editor today (found by
  the ELK proof lane; the fix is in flight on fix/shelf-only-layout), so this
  form is reviewable in the browser only once that fix lands. Solve, lint and
  audits unchanged; eight :: lines to port.
  Later again (Felix's ruling, the kind-head rule): the eight kind heads now
  state the shared THESIS of their objections in the objector's voice, general
  enough that every member is an instance (a reader arrives with a proposition
  in their head and matches by content); their glosses open on the member list.
  Label and gloss text only, no line moved. The rule's scope, decided the
  same day: a kind card nested under an objection shelf states the thesis;
  a document-level shelf keeps its question head.
  Later still (Felix's ruling on the nested merge): ::halt-enforcement moved
  whole out of ::policy-batteries into ::feasibility, after the lemma
  cluster's last line, its five families with their quotes and comments; the
  two shelf glosses re-cut to say what each now holds. FOR THE PORT LANES:
  nine :: lines moved or added in all since the 2026-08-21 parity: eight kind
  heads added (::halt-costs, ::halt-enforcement, ::halt-alternatives,
  ::halt-messaging, ::halt-granted, ::plan-technique, ::plan-world,
  ::plan-racing), of which ::halt-enforcement then moved into ::feasibility,
  plus the re-cut glosses on the ::feasibility and ::policy-batteries heads;
  the families under them moved whole, by kind, with no member text changed.
  PORTED 2026-09-09, the same evening, by three parallel lanes (DE, TW, CN,
  each a mechanical rebuild by id before translating, TRANSLATION_NOTES §3
  step 0): translation-parity is green on all three pairs.
  2026-09-12: the chapter 14 close ("Now let's consider what can be done, and
  by whom") mapped as a refinement under @c13-winnable, one statement per
  addressee plus the chapter's own grounds and its carrying sentence, three
  convergent routes in; @c13-winnable's pin became its check. The option-value
  ask for the unpersuaded politician sits in ::feasibility as @c14-brakes. Three
  corrections from the same day's coverage audit: $resp-chips re-glossed on the
  book's deliberately low threshold (the old gloss said the opposite), the
  incentives passage re-located from the ch. 13 to the ch. 12 locator, and a
  chapter-level [^supp-ch10] locator on the chapter 10 battery. ::halt-granted
  re-headed to name the fatalist member. EN first; -de/-tw/-cn ported the same
  day (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-09-12).
source: "https://ifanyonebuildsit.com/resources"
# The reader-facing half of the provenance (site-map-attribution, 2026-08-03):
# `source` above is a maintainer's link and `author` records the extraction
# round, so neither can be printed under a reader's map. This one is written to
# be read at a glance — the viewer renders it whole at the foot of the app.
# EN only for now; the DE/TW/CN ports own their own edition wording.
source-title: "If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies, by Eliezer Yudkowsky & Nate Soares (Little, Brown, 2025)"
# Focus nodes (D57): declared, not derived — the coalition-strategy goal
# guards (c13co, EN; ported batches later) premise on @shutdown as a
# world-layer conjunct without arguing FROM it, which would drop it from
# sink derivation. This is the map's complete focus list.
focus: [everyone-dies, shutdown]
glossary:
  # Auto-glossary (editor-auto-glossary, 2026-07-19): terms the editor
  # underlines in node texts; tap/hover shows the explanation. The DE map
  # carries the full set (FEEDBACK T4/T8); these prove per-language symmetry.
  - term: ASI
    exact: true
    gloss: >
      Artificial superintelligence: an AI that far surpasses every human at
      practically every cognitive task.
  - term: gradient descent
    match: [gradient]
    gloss: >
      The standard mathematical procedure by which modern AI models are
      trained ("grown"): billions of internal numbers are nudged in tiny
      steps so the outputs score better. Nobody designs the result: it
      emerges.
  - term: RLHF
    exact: true
    gloss: >
      "Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback": post-training in which
      human ratings shape a model: first a reward model learns which answers
      people prefer, then the language model is optimized against it.
  - term: alignment
    gloss: >
      The problem of building AI systems that reliably pursue their creators'
      goals and values, rather than whatever the training process happened
      to produce.
# 2026-07-17 — D36 re-authoring pass (EN ONLY; -de/-tw NOT yet updated, so
# translation parity is intentionally broken until their pass): (1) the 29
# derived (concluded-into) statement pins migrated to display-only check
# credences per the residual authoring rule (D36 item 3) — recorded as
# trailing `# check: p` comments pending a syntax slot; frontier-root
# marginals kept (residual by definition). (2) The four Ch12 meta-objections
# re-typed from ~@everyone-dies undercuts of $link-fine to ~@shutdown
# undercuts of $shutdown-fine (they dispute raising the alarm, not the
# inference). (3) $link-fine's remaining undercut strengths re-elicited as
# operative defeat rates (SOLVER_REFINEMENT_DELIVERY-2026-07-17 §6.3).
# 2026-07-17 (same day, follow-on) — spine-badge content repairs (EN ONLY;
# parity still broken): the check badges the pin migration exposed, repaired
# by type: (a) named support added where the deleted pins had carried the
# whole load (@opaque, @race-dynamics, @one-cavalier-suffices, @not-preserved
# via @no-right-care/@not-useful, @analogy-apt, plus ~@nat-abs and
# ~@prompt-feasible counter-mass); (b) battery-AND rules split along the
# book's own convergent routes ($adv-ev, $power-ev, $ik-ev, $nuclear-curses,
# $wst-ev, $ext-ev); (c) overlapping/template strengths re-elicited
# ($hard1+$hard2 merged, $eng*, $inner-*, $nat-from-llm, $treaty-ev);
# (d) $mwb-time's "even if solvable" made explicit (~@align-hard partition).
# Two badges deliberately remained (see AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-17):
# @align-hard (0.71 vs 0.55 — the crux tension, the author's inputs earn more
# than their bottom line) and @not-preserved (0.56 vs 0.8 — the c5 hope
# battery's aggregation-under-independence question, tracked as an idea).
# 2026-07-17 (same day, follow-on 2) — the @not-preserved badge closed by the
# T32 hope-family aggregation repair (hope_family_probe.py): the 18 c5
# objections now share @spare-motive (0.25, family-holistic) as a world-layer
# conjunct, so the family grinds as one doubt, not 18 → 0.71 vs check 0.8.
# @align-hard is now the map's single deliberate badge.
# (Corrected 2026-08-03: that sentence has been stale since the 2026-07-19
# re-elicitation, which CLOSED the @align-hard badge at 0.928 vs 0.90
# (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-19, trajectory row "4 align-hard"); the 2026-07-25
# corrigibility batch reopened only a +0.057 check-side gap, still inside the
# 0.10 badge threshold, and it solves 0.957 vs 0.90 today. The map's
# deliberate badges are the post-campaign list below; the live badge in this
# region is @corrig-antinatural, 0.658 solved vs 0.85 check.)
# 2026-07-17 (same day, follow-on 3) — AUTHOR-FAITHFUL re-elicitation of the
# @not-preserved region (machinery stress test; AUTHORING_NOTES entry). All
# numbers there are pre-registered from the book authors' verbatim confidence
# language via a fixed rubric, BEFORE solving; @spare-motive is superseded by
# the authors' own defeaters as cluster conjuncts, and the four hope clusters
# nest under coarse wrapper evidences ($hope-care/-useful/-harmless/-design).
# (The provenance seam this created was retired 2026-07-19 — see below.)
# 2026-07-18 — chance reification of the policy step (EN ONLY; parity with
# -de/-tw still intentionally broken): $shutdown-ev's refinement now reifies
# the objective chance (@risk-material) and the norm (@no-gamble) so the
# book's threshold argument ("a material risk of the implication is an
# insane gamble") is first-order representable; $shutdown-fine re-routed to
# condition on them (strength 0.7 -> 0.85, near-deductive once its premises
# are granted). W1 count unchanged (two: $shutdown-ev, $risk-from-link).
# Same-day follow-on (covariance
# defect, AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-18 follow-on): @risk-material re-worded to
# the epistemic-fact @risk-unbounded ("no one can bound the risk below the
# threshold"), @no-thresholds moved into its support ($unbounded-thresh),
# $shutdown-fine two-premise 0.9, $bounded-escape names the conditionality.
# 2026-07-19 — AUTHOR-FAITHFUL RE-ELICITATION, MAP-WIDE (EN ONLY until the
# -de/-tw port; ideas/plans/reelicit-author-faithful.md executed): all ~360
# re-elicitable values re-derived blind (numbers stripped) from the authors'
# verbatim register by five independent elicitors under the pilot rubric +
# six pre-registered extensions (R-NORM deontic, R-STEP inference language,
# R-OPP opponent grounds, R-FALLBACK silence, R-COARSE summaries, R-COMPOSE
# stacked hedges — AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-19). Pre-registered before any
# solve; nothing moved after. The old provenance seam is RETIRED: checks are
# now the authors' credences everywhere; reviewer-voiced checks (e.g.
# @everyone-dies 0.55, @shutdown 0.5) survive only in git history.
# RESIDUALS at role defaults: @nn-generalize, @sgd-bias, @rlhf-bilevel,
# @ml-defies (reviewer-sourced technical grounds), $enf-hard (mapmaker
# bridge), @tk-realization (route narration the coda refuses to rate).
# 2026-08-23 (two-floor pass): four more POSITIVE pins are reviewer-sourced
# rather than author-sourced, and are logged here rather than left silent:
# @learning-better (no author sentence grants it; the nearest page argues the
# other way), @opaque-dynamics (Bushnaq, though the ch. 2 supplement says the
# same flat), @gd-direct (the evolution-analogy essays) and @gen-not-values
# (reviewer ground, no locator). Each keeps its class pair; only
# @learning-better's is written from the role-default shape.
# Deliberate badges after the campaign: @evo-analogy 0.45 vs 0.85 (the
# authors' own concessions + reviewer grounds under-deliver their C3
# confidence in the evolution analogy) and the overshoot family
# (@wed-lose, @mis-ext, @no-right-care, @risk-unbounded — crush-rebutted
# batteries compound past the hedged summaries: "steps outrun summaries").
# Headline: @everyone-dies solves 0.898 vs authors' 0.93; @shutdown 0.978
# vs 0.93. W1 count unchanged (two: $shutdown-ev, $risk-from-link).
# 2026-07-25 — "Will there be warning shots?" supplement integrated (EN ONLY until the
# -de/-tw port, landed 2026-07-27): the
# wait-for-a-warning-shot objection docked as a @shutdown battery triple
# (@c13-waitshot / $obj-waitshot / $resp-waitshot), with the supplement's
# failure-mode case folded under $resp-waitshot's refinement (14 statements +
# 16 evidences, c13ws- prefix; delivery line $c13ws-fine). @opaque [Ch2] and
# @wed-lose [Ch6] gain cross-region consumers (Tier-1 manifest updated). All
# numbers pre-registered from the supplement's verbatim register via the
# existing rubric families (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-25) before the first
# post-edit solve; none moved after. W1 count unchanged (two: $shutdown-ev,
# $risk-from-link).
# 2026-07-25 — value/stakes/consciousness supplement batch integrated (EN ONLY until the
# -de/-tw port, landed 2026-07-27):
# four pages, one batch — the ch1/ch5 consciousness pair as a top-level
# scoping cluster (c5c- + a c1 battery entry: intelligence needs no
# consciousness, the book's case is scoped to capability; the one-line
# "Would smarter-than-human AI be conscious?" stub is absorbed there);
# "Losing the Future" as the stakes cluster beside @everyone-dies (c5f- —
# deliberately no edge into the doom marginal: stakes, not probability);
# and the succession objection ("let the smarter species inherit") as a
# @shutdown battery triple with the cosmopolitan answer + AI-welfare rights
# position folded under $c5v-resp (c5v-). @grown [Ch2],
# @instrumental-convergence [Ch5], @c5-little [Ch5] gain cross-region
# consumers (Tier-1 manifest updated). All numbers pre-registered from the
# supplements' verbatim register via the existing rubric families
# (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-25 batch entry) before the first post-edit
# solve; none moved after. W1 count unchanged (two: $shutdown-ev,
# $risk-from-link).
# 2026-07-25 batch 3 — the ch13 positive-program pair integrated (EN ONLY until the
# -de/-tw port, landed 2026-07-27):
# two short pages, pro-side strategy and morale, so mostly NOT battery
# material. "Is the situation hopeless?" IS objection-shaped (grants the
# doom case, denies acting helps) and docks as a @shutdown battery triple
# (@c13-hopeless / $obj-hopeless / $resp-hopeless, unguarded — winnability
# and worth stand whether or not the risk is demonstrated). "Keep the
# Coalition Large" is a strategy NORM, not evidence for or against the
# policy: hub @c13co-single with two convergent routes (the
# needed+fragile mechanism, the cold-war precedent), both carrying
# @shutdown as a GOAL GUARD — the 2026-07-20 guard convention generalized
# to advice that presupposes pursuing the ban; deliberately no edge into
# @prompt-feasible/@treaty-feasible (mapmaker bridge). 8 statements + 5
# evidences, prefix c13co- added. No Tier-1 node gains a cross-region
# consumer (all reuse is region-internal @shutdown/@risk-unbounded-free).
# All numbers pre-registered from the pages' verbatim register via the
# existing rubric families (AUTHORING_NOTES 2026-07-25 batch 3) before
# the first post-edit solve; none moved after. W1 count unchanged (two:
# $shutdown-ev, $risk-from-link).
# 2026-07-25 batch 4 — the final two ch4 supplement pages integrated (EN ONLY until the
